description: This file serves as the initializer for the 'together' module within the 'pipecat.services' package. It imports the 'sys' module and a 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' from 'pipecat.services', then imports everything from the local '.llm' submodule. Finally, it assigns a 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' instance to 'sys.modules[__name__]', effectively wrapping the module with deprecation handling or proxy behavior.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark modules as deprecated and possibly provide warning or alternative behavior.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy, initializes proxy with the wrapped module, name, and message.
